crossRefs.note: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries…
How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can’t know…
Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent…
They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
For I know how many your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who…
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…

translations.web: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
translations.bsb: Wisdom is too high for a fool; he does not open his mouth in the meeting place.
translations.kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
translations.asv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: He openeth not his mouth in the gate.
